SELECT 
                p.productID,
                p.productName,
                p.isActive,
                COUNT(l.licenseID) as totalLicenses,
                SUM(CASE WHEN l.isActivated = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as activatedLicenses,
                SUM(l.pricePaid) as totalRevenue
            FROM product p
            LEFT JOIN license l ON p.productID = l.productID
            GROUP BY p.productID, p.productName, p.isActive
            ORDER BY totalRevenue DESC

SELECT 
			   l.*,
			   p.productName,
			   p.productImage,
			   CASE
				 WHEN l.countDown = 1 THEN '1 lần'
				 WHEN l.countDown = 5 THEN '5 lần'
				 WHEN l.countDown = 10 THEN '10 lần'
				 ELSE CONCAT(l.countDown, ' lần')
			   END AS licenseTypeName
			FROM license l
			INNER JOIN product p ON l.productID = p.productID
			WHERE l.licenseKey = ?

SELECT           
                ull.licenseKey           AS licenseKey,
                p.productName            AS productName,
                p.productImage           AS productImage,
                ull.purchaseTime         AS purchaseTime,
                ull.pricePaid            AS pricePaid,
                l.activeTime             AS activeTime,
                l.countDown              AS countDown,
                l.status                 AS licenseStatus
            FROM user_link_license ull
            JOIN user u       ON ull.userID = u.userID
            JOIN license l    ON ull.licenseKey = l.licenseKey
            LEFT JOIN product p ON l.productID = p.productID
            WHERE ull.userID = ?

SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM api_logs

SELECT 
                userID,
                userName,
                COUNT(*) as request_count,
                MAX(created_at) as last_request
            FROM api_logs
            WHERE userID IS NOT NULL
            AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL ? DAY)
            GROUP BY userID, userName
            ORDER BY request_count DESC
            LIMIT 10

SELECT 
                ip_address,
                COUNT(*) as request_count,
                COUNT(DISTINCT userID) as unique_users,
                MAX(created_at) as last_request
            FROM api_logs
            WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL ? DAY)
            GROUP BY ip_address
            ORDER BY request_count DESC
            LIMIT 10

SELECT 
                event_type,
                event_category,
                COUNT(*) as count
            FROM api_logs
            WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL ? DAY)
            GROUP BY event_type, event_category
            ORDER BY count DESC
            LIMIT 20

SELECT 
                response_status,
                COUNT(*) as count
            FROM api_logs
            WHERE response_status >= 400
            AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL ? DAY)
            GROUP BY response_status
            ORDER BY count DESC
